description: This Java class 'FileHelper' provides utility methods for file handling within the RomRaider application, such as obtaining file choosers for profiles, definitions, and logging output directories, as well as saving profiles to files.

classes.name: FileHelper
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for file handling, including obtaining file choosers for profiles, definitions, logger output directories, and saving user profiles to files.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns a File object for the given path, or the user's home directory if the path is null or empty.

methods.name: getProfileFileChooser
methods.description: Creates a JFileChooser configured for selecting profile XML files, initialized with the last profile file location.

methods.name: getDefinitionFileChooser
methods.description: Creates a JFileChooser configured for selecting definition XML files, initialized with the last definition file location.

methods.name: saveProfileToFile
methods.description: Saves a UserProfile object to the specified file, appending '.xml' extension if necessary, and returns the file path.

methods.name: getLoggerOutputDirFileChooser
methods.description: Creates a JFileChooser for selecting a directory for logger output, initialized with the last directory if valid.

methods.name: getFileChooser
methods.description: Internal method that creates a JFileChooser with a specified file filter based on provided file, description, and extensions.

methods.name: getFileChooser (overload)
methods.description: Internal method that creates a JFileChooser initialized to the parent directory of the provided file.
